title: Spike bot goes live
text: Watches Kick and Twitch chat, spots sudden surges and posts the moment with a VOD link to #moments.

title: #status and #daily-summary
text: Health alerts (restarts, streams live/offline, chat down, low disk) and a 22:00 daily summary.

title: Auto-deploy
text: Anything pushed to main goes live on the server within a couple of minutes.

title: Lacy mode
text: Lacy's GTA chat spikes become captioned Shorts with his facecam on top.

title: Tokyo Girl edits
text: Silent GTA 6 edits from official Rockstar trailers, made daily for TikTok/IG.

title: Posting to all platforms
text: Shorts go to YouTube, Instagram Reels and a TikTok copy; big files go through the storage bucket.

title: Discord approval bot
text: 3 versions per clip in #ready-to-post; nothing posts until you press Approve. #inspiration saves styles as presets.

title: /feedback and rules
text: Tell the editor what to change in plain words; text levels, logo intro, an AI read of #inspiration videos.

title: Launch-day auto-watch
text: Watches the biggest live GTA VI streams at once and ranks their moments.

title: Cuts on the beat
text: Tokyo Girl edits cut on the real beats and drop of the song.

title: Motion-design renderer
text: Remotion renders Tokyo Girl edits (Ken Burns, punches, kinetic text), with ffmpeg as the fallback.

title: Trending-sound edits
text: /trend makes trailer edits cut to your trending sounds, 3 times a day.

title: Progress bars and 📊 Stats
text: Live progress bars with time left; stats channels for live streamers, moments and reviews.

title: /cancel
text: Stop any render, analysis or download by its run id, or with the bar's Cancel button.

title: /rules
text: Every rule numbered and grouped, with a Turn off / Turn on button beside each.

title: Rule compiler
text: Saved notes turn into real settings automatically; anything new becomes a code request.

title: Feedback keeps the same clips
text: Re-renders keep exactly the same clips unless you ask for new ones, and can switch the sound.

title: Sharper video
text: CRF 18 everywhere; stream clips at the stream's own frame rate up to 60 fps, trailer edits at 30.

title: Stream clips for every programme
text: Adin Ross, Seal and Kai Cenat get the Lacy pipeline; the facecam is found automatically.

title: Nudity check
text: Every video is scanned before review and again before posting; anything flagged is deleted.

title: #announcements
text: New rules, live post links, blocked videos and deploy notes in one place.

title: Titles from what was said
text: Claude writes stream clip titles and captions from the transcript; templates as fallback.

title: TikTok auto-post
text: Approved videos post to TikTok through its API (drafts in the inbox for silent edits).

title: Audio highlights
text: Loud moments in the VOD audio become clips even when chat didn't spike.

title: /help
text: Every command and button by category, with search.

title: Framing and GTA 5 vs 6
text: 4:5, 1:1 and stacked framings with smart fill; GTA 5 vs GTA 6 comparison edits (/compare).

title: Better stats and CPU report
text: Accurate live count, GTA 6 countdown, views/likes/followers; daily summary shows server CPU.

title: 45 editor rules built
text: Every pending rule request is now a real editor setting.

title: Compact review cards
text: A | B | C side by side; #inspiration tells edits from stream clips.

title: Captions from the streamer only
text: Game audio (cutscenes, NPCs, radio) is left out of captions; more footage variety.

title: Impact filter
text: Chat answering a question, sub thank-yous and weak moments are skipped before editing.

title: 7 new campaigns
text: Kai Cenat, YourRAGE, Clix, Dasgasd3m, Bobby Vanriper, KreekCraft and BrettLiftsXP, each with its own rules. `/campaigns`.

title: Budget watch
text: When a campaign ends or runs out of budget, that streamer gets no more clips.

title: Campaign rules in captions
text: Required hashtags and "watch live" links go in captions, never in the video; no AI content.

title: 4:5 edits
text: Edits are 4:5 and never crop off text or the subject; clips without a facecam are 4:5 too.

title: TikTok-style captions
text: TikTok Sans, no movement or fades, 1.5 s longer on screen. Sound effects removed.

title: Best 10 a day
text: Each streamer gets at most 10 clips a day: the best-rated moments, not the first ones.

title: Better hooks
text: A short on-screen hook that sets up the moment; #inspiration notes how captions look.

title: One review message
text: #ready-to-post is one message: pick a video in the drop-down to expand and approve it.

title: YouTube stats
text: ▶️ YouTube views, subscribers and Shorts in 📊 Stats. `/stats youtube_channel:@handle` if needed.

title: #updates
text: This channel: every change to the bot, briefly.

title: Clips from live streams fixed
text: Kai, Lacy, KreekCraft and YourRAGE clips no longer fail while they're live: only the needed VOD parts are downloaded, and clips wait if it's too early.

title: Lacy is he/him
text: Titles, captions and hooks always use each streamer's own pronouns; anything wrong falls back to templates.

title: ClipUp logo campaign
text: ClipUp's logo (top right, whole clip) + #gta6 #Clipup on clips whose campaign allows logos. Never Lacy, Clix or YourRAGE.

title: Brett and Dasgasd3m rules
text: Brett: face on screen and @BrettLiftsXP tag in every clip. Dasgasd3m: "Sponsored" in captions, stops after 19 Dec.
